svg.title: CoreS3 Acceleration axis reference
svg.desc: X points to the product right, Y to the product top, Z out of the front. Hold the device still. Point one positive axis upward. That component should read about +1 g. Point it downward: about −1 g.

g.text: Specific force along X, Y and Z
That component should read about +1 g.
X+ right · Y+ top · Z+ out of front
At rest, accel includes the gravity response; it is not zero.
